name: stance-retreat-repair
description: retreat when damaged, to a place of repair: three tanks with retreat at 50% are hurt to 35%; they dock at the repair building, come back to full health and go back to where they stood. The repair building is looked up by KindOf (@REPAIR_PAD: a structure of the America side if the data has one, else of any side); the trace names it on the line "ASSISTTEST created 1 x ...". "cannot create @REPAIR_PAD": the data has no such structure. "cannot use facility" or "goes to the rally point": the building does not repair tanks. (Needs the commits with MSG_ASSIST_STANCE; until then "this build has no command".)
steps: until not atsnapshot tanks tol=60 max=300
log: ^ASSIST stance set mask=2 value=2 percent=50 for 3 units

log.match: ^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ at 35% goes to repair facility \d+
^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ goes back to -?\d+,-?\d+ at 100%
